authorization: 2026-10-27: explicit A ten-task and B three-task execution through result delivery. This supersedes the previous no-ten-task gate only for these two runs; old results remain immutable.

arms.A: Federated utility plus unchanged original SSB, T1-T10; import committed original federated T3
arms.B: Federated utility plus historical boundary repair, T1-T3; import original shared T1, independent thereafter

comparisons: Existing standard LoRM seed0 at each corresponding stage, plus previous three-task federated result as internal reference. No new LoRM, RRS, Central, seeds, alpha, or optimizer arms.
readout: Fixed per-task block mean subtraction, all seen classes without oracle task ID; report raw equally completely.

boundary_repair.loss: Formal current-task CE; cross loss mean softplus(max centered old logit minus centered true logit) on detached current-task-correct mask from same augmented forward.
boundary_repair.base: Original five-step SSB of EMA .9 M + .1 g; exactly one B optimizer and one CE-only AdamW head step. Use actual FP32 B and head displacements.
boundary_repair.metric: Q=I+ A H_old A.T / max(trace(H_old)/input_dim,1e-12); symmetric, Cholesky verified and cached after final A. Only committed old history, shared Q/V metric.
boundary_repair.solution: Global q=T(h)-T(g)<g,T(h)>/<g,T(g)>; b=max(0,<h,Delta0>+<h_w,Delta_w>); delta_star=-b q/<h,q>. One global cap scale for norm_Q(delta)<=.25 norm_Q(Delta0). Correction never enters EMA or head.
boundary_repair.degenerate: T1, empty mask, b=0: zero. Exactly zero g removes equality; zero h cannot repair head conflict; nonpositive/nonfinite/relative-degenerate denominator skips with reason; zero base norm gives zero cap.
boundary_repair.numeric: FP64 joint reductions and geometry; record ideal and actually deployed FP32 corrections, explicit rounding envelopes, normalized orthogonality residual, cap and remaining conflict. Any nonfinite gradient/parameter or geometry error outside rounding allowance is a technical stop, not a performance gate.
boundary_repair.certificate_scope: Existing selected-A certificates only qualify original SSB proposals, not the repaired training update. No finite-step, old-class, or post-FedAvg loss guarantee.

finite_step_windows: B T2/T3, client0: round0 step0 and final local step; round4 final local step. Two extra forwards compare base and corrected B with same updated head, augmentation and fixed mask. Restore buffers, modes, RNG and committed corrected parameters; optimizers unmodified by observation.
preflight: 13 deterministic CPU math/lifecycle checks; one disposable real T2 minibatch (inherited T1 basis), old-head gradient/freeze and CE-only head/EMA exactly-once verification; restore imported checkpoint and RNG before formal task initialization. All real preflight time/images charged separately.
stops: No stopping for low accuracy, rare triggers, heavy clipping or absent gain. Continue to frozen horizons if implementation valid. No unbounded retry, no clock reset, no test-driven parameter changes. Stop technical nonfinite/inconsistent state or hard budget and preserve evidence.
qualification: Actual final checkpoint full reload on A 10000/B 3000 images; raw/centered predictions identical to saved final record, max logit difference reported; exact lifecycle and training counts. Preserve historical per-stage metrics, never replace with final-model backtesting.
delivery: Chinese A/B and combined reports, complete raw/centered triangular matrices, AIA/forgetting/restricted/competition counts, LoRM paired scope and net differences, repair diagnostics and actual costs. Publish code/config/protocol/aggregate results only; retain weights, Grams, gradients, prototypes and per-image artifacts privately. One 30-minute session monitor until both validated and delivered.
